official_definition: You can summon this card from the Hand by paying the summon cost from your Reserve, or paying it by sending cores from your Red/Green Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void. When you've done so, you can send the 20px from your Reserve/Field to your Life.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Sound Speed Seal] or [Sound Speed Seal: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Sound Speed Seal]", "give [Sound Speed Seal]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
